question: Should OpenClaw accept static `sandbox.docker.env` SecretRefs when resolved values still become Docker environment variables visible through Docker/container metadata?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but accepting this feature is a security/product boundary choice because SecretRef-backed credentials still become Docker-visible env values.

options.title: Accept With Explicit Boundary
options.body: Land the linked pull request only after maintainer/security approval confirms the existing Docker metadata warning is acceptable for SecretRef-backed env values.

options.title: Require Stronger Warning First
options.body: Ask the linked pull request to explicitly name SecretRef-backed Docker env exposure in docs before merge.

options.title: Reject Env-Based Delivery
options.body: Pause or reject the linked pull request and design a non-env secret delivery contract if Docker metadata exposure is unacceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept With Explicit Boundary
recommendation.body: Land the linked pull request only after maintainer/security approval confirms the existing Docker metadata warning is acceptable for SecretRef-backed env values.
